checks.setup: Front oblique and side sheets inspected; complete body and apparatus visible.
checks.hands: Both closed hands stay on machine handles.
checks.feet: Left forefoot contacts the plate edge with heel free; right foot remains on a separate fixed rest.
checks.movement: Unilateral calf press on a 45-degree leg press. Left knee fixed at 165 degrees, ankle plantarflexes over 4 seconds and returns over 4 seconds. Left forefoot only on the plate; right leg bent with foot on separate fixed support. Hands retain handles, pelvis and back fixed.

limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
